description: Find published archive records by text when you do not know an exact story ID. All space-separated terms must match as case-insensitive substrings across IDs, titles, summaries, tags, products, beats, evidence status, contributions, or source labels/release IDs. Returns newest-first stories, normalized query, count, feed receipt, and release identity, preserving evidence clocks and limitations. No relevance ranking or pagination; zero matches returns an empty list. Public and read-only; no sign-in. The feed is cached for up to 60 seconds; invalid queries or unavailable/invalid feeds return a tool error.

limit.description: Maximum matching records to return, newest first; 1 to 20, default 10. Does not change which terms must match.

query.description: Plain text, for example "dollar funding" or a source release ID. Unicode NFKC-normalized, trimmed, and whitespace-collapsed; every term must match. At most 12 terms, 160 characters, and 512 UTF-8 bytes after normalization. No quote, Boolean, regex, or semantic-search syntax.

name: search_stories

outputSchema.description: Published archive records with a feed receipt and deployed MCP release identity. Evidence dates describe the source record; fetched_at describes retrieval, not market freshness.

count.description: Number of records returned, not the total number of matches.

feed.description: Canonical feed URL, content hash, item count, publication authority, and retrieval timestamp.

query.description: The Unicode-normalized query with leading/trailing whitespace removed and internal whitespace collapsed.

release.description: MCP version and deployed source SHA, when available.

stories.description: Newest-first published records retaining stable IDs, source links, evidence clocks, publication state, release IDs, and limitations.

title: Search evidence-bounded stories
